column3: The Hebrew leaves Jeroboam unnamed and uses singular “house of high places”; BSB names Jeroboam and uses plural “shrines.”
The Hebrew says that he went up on the altar; BSB renders this as offering sacrifices on it.

The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed and twice says that he went up on the altar; BSB names Jeroboam and describes offering sacrifices. The Hebrew says the month was devised “from his heart”; BSB says “of his own choosing.”
